description: This file implements an output interceptor for Unix-like systems, providing functionality to clone, redirect, restore, and shut down stdout and stderr file descriptors, primarily for capturing or redirecting output during testing or execution.

classes.name: dupSyscallOutputInterceptorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of output interception using Unix system calls to clone, redirect, and restore stdout and stderr.

methods.name: CreateStdoutStderrClones
methods.description: Creates clones of stdout and stderr file descriptors, sets FD_CLOEXEC flag, and wraps them in os.File objects.

methods.name: ConnectPipeToStdoutStderr
methods.description: Redirects stdout and stderr to a pipe writer file descriptor using Dup2.

methods.name: RestoreStdoutStderrFromClones
methods.description: Restores stdout and stderr from their clones, effectively restoring original file descriptors.

methods.name: ShutdownClones
methods.description: Closes the clone file descriptors for cleanup.
